workstream_a_parity.gate_reason: Strict continuous parity (rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) is bounded by Intel oneDNN vs Microsoft MLAS micro-architectural GEMM accumulation in CNN layers (max error 6.10e-5; 98.9627% elements within 1e-5; 99.9964% within 2e-5; 100% within 1e-4). Direct extraction on identical inputs shows 5 bit errors across 6,553,600 bits (BER=7.63e-7; 95/100 images exact). Separate end-to-end roundtrip extraction on respective stego outputs is 100% bit-exact (0 bit errors across 6,553,600 bits; 100/100 images exact).

direct_extraction_same_input_parity.description: PyTorch extract_spatial vs ONNX extract_spatial fed identical carrier tensor

separate_roundtrip_parity.description: PyTorch embed->extract vs ONNX embed->extract on respective stego outputs

rs_2t_32.evaluation: High capacity (7,090 B raw / 7,088 B reference). Conservative operating restriction of <= 1,000 B advised due to Poisson error tail risk on large payloads (80% recovery at 5,000 B), though 100B, 1000B, and 2500B trials succeed 100%.

rs_2t_48.evaluation: Primary qualified deployment profile (6,578 B raw / 6,576 B reference). 100% exact recovery across all evaluated payload classes (100B to 5000B) with fresh receiver instances and boundary tests.

rs_2t_64.evaluation: Maximum theoretical resilience profile (6,066 B raw / 6,064 B reference). 100% exact recovery across all evaluated lossless payloads; empirical channel degradation under noise remains untested and unmeasured.

operating_envelope.lossless_png: Fully supported: 100.0% exact recovery (3/3 trials pass; PSNR >= inf, SSIM >= 1.0).
operating_envelope.additive_noise_sigma_0.5: Fully supported: 100.0% exact recovery (9/9 trials pass; BER <= 0.39%; error margin absorbs noise).
operating_envelope.additive_noise_sigma_1.0: Operating boundary (Partial): 33.33% exact recovery (3/9 trials pass; remaining trials fail closed via MaskGenerationError, HEADER_CORRUPTED).
operating_envelope.additive_noise_sigma_2.0: Unsupported: 0.0% recovery (0/9 trials pass; all fail closed via HEADER_CORRUPTED; zero plaintext leak).
operating_envelope.lossy_jpeg_q95_q85_q75: Unsupported: 0.0% recovery across all JPEG qualities; all fail closed via CarrierHeaderError; zero plaintext leak.

policy_decision.framing_protocol: CarrierHeader.flags bits 0..3 unambiguously encode ECC profile: 0x00 -> 2t=32, 0x01 -> 2t=48, 0x02 -> 2t=64.
policy_decision.interoperability: Fresh receiver pipeline automatically adapts to sender's profile via header.ecc_parity; capacity gates enforce profile-specific limits fail-closed.
policy_decision.bit_interleaving_status: Theoretical analysis completed; documented as architectural recommendation for Phase 6 (not claimed as implemented).
